# Controlled Lorebook fixtures

These small fixtures were hand-authored for LivingWorld C-004C1. No community
lorebooks or SillyTavern implementation code were copied. `world_info.json`
exercises native object-map entries and inert advanced metadata.
`embedded_character_book.json` is attached to the existing controlled V2/V3
Character Card fixtures in tests, then consumed from C-004B's preserved boundary.

Both include blank-content source entries: these remain recoverable in complete
source data with warnings and never become canonical LoreEntry objects.
